temporal_state_chain.observed: Teresa seems overburdened and overwhelmed by her tasks; she initially says she can manage but has a lot to do, then accepts Arthur's offer to help organize medical supplies.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: No specific belief that Teresa needs help; unaware of the extent of her burden.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Arthur forms the belief that Teresa is overburdened and could benefit from assistance.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Teresa needs help and is willing to accept some assistance; helping her is appropriate.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned, empathetic, and motivated to help.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Offer assistance and help Teresa organize the medical supplies.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Teresa confirms she wants to show she can do tasks by herself, but after Arthur's reassurance she agrees that teamwork can make them more effective.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Teresa is hesitant to accept help because she wants to prove her capability and be self-reliant.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Confirmed and refined; Teresa's hesitation is tied to self-reliance, and she is receptive to reassurance that accepting help does not undermine her ability.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Teresa wants to be capable independently, but she understands that accepting help and working as a team is acceptable and valuable; Arthur sees she may still need ongoing support.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Reassure Teresa and support her without making her feel inadequate; encourage teamwork.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Teresa says she is busy and falling behind despite earlier reassurance; she agrees to try working together instead of Arthur simply helping her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Teresa is still struggling despite Arthur's reassurance, and his previous efforts to help have not yielded enough results.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Confirmed; Teresa remains burdened, and the previous approach was insufficient, so a new collaborative approach is needed.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Teresa needs a different, more shared approach; working together may support her without making her feel inadequate.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Frustrated and concerned, but determined to find a better way.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Find another way to support Teresa without making her feel inadequate; try tackling tasks as a team.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Teresa agrees the collaborative approach already feels less overwhelming; they divide tasks and plan to check in regularly.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Working together will ease Teresa's burden and improve their efficiency.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Strengthened; Teresa's positive response and the concrete plan reinforce Arthur's hope that collaboration will work.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: The collaborative approach is promising and worth fully committing to.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Fully commit to the collaborative approach; handle inventory while Teresa manages patient records and check in regularly.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Arthur perceives that their teamwork paid off and accomplished more together; Teresa agrees, values the experience, and supports continuing collaboration in future projects.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Their collaboration has been going well and has likely strengthened their professional relationship.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Confirmed; the collaboration succeeded, was mutually valued, and improved their working relationship.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: The collaborative approach should be maintained in future projects because it improves efficiency, effectiveness, and their professional relationship.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Maintain the collaborative approach in future projects and continue being a supportive colleague.
